headline: Study finds task reward can hide inaccurate latent world dynamics
summary: A new arXiv preprint proposes latent rollout consistency (LRC) to test whether a learned model’s action-conditioned latent predictions track the states inferred from realized observations. Across DreamerV3, TD-MPC2 and LeWM on three deliberately simple DeepMind Control Suite tasks, the authors report that strong task reward can coexist with inaccurate latent rollouts. Pixel inputs generally worsen rollout prediction, while adding velocity partly improves results for some models. The finding is an author-reported result in controlled low-dimensional environments; it does not establish that deployed or real-world world models generally fail to represent their environments.
